title: Configure Lemon Squeezy test Pro variants
description: Create the GoPort Pro product in Lemon Squeezy test mode with monthly (USD 2.99, matching the current 7-day trial offer) and yearly (USD 19.99) subscription variants, then set LEMON_SQUEEZY_PRO_MONTHLY_VARIANT_ID and LEMON_SQUEEZY_PRO_YEARLY_VARIANT_ID in the ignored backend app/.env and deployment secrets.
acceptance_criteria: Both dashboard upgrade buttons open a Lemon Squeezy test checkout; the 4242 4242 4242 4242 test card completes checkout; signed webhooks activate Pro and persist subscription plus transaction records.

title: Integrate Lemon Squeezy Pro subscriptions
description: Implement test-mode Lemon Squeezy checkout, signed webhook synchronization, PocketBase subscription and transaction storage, dashboard billing UI, and backend enforcement for Pro-only tunnel features.
design: Keep handler-service-repository layering. Treat Lemon Squeezy webhooks as source of truth. Verify HMAC over raw request bytes and make event processing idempotent through unique external IDs.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated users can open test checkout and customer portal; signed webhooks update idempotent subscription and transaction records; dashboard displays real billing state; custom subdomains and TCP tunnels require an active Pro subscription; secrets stay ignored; tests and builds pass.
notes: Implemented and verified backend/service/repository layers, private PocketBase billing collections, signed idempotent webhooks, Lemon checkout and portal APIs, dashboard billing UI, Free/Pro enforcement, downgrade handling, and quota accounting. Lemon test webhook 133771 is configured for https://back.goport.uz/api/v1/billing/webhook. Quality gates: go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., TypeScript noEmit, ESLint (0 errors; pre-existing warnings), Next production build, fresh migration smoke test, and HTTP authorization/limit smoke test all passed. Product variants remain external setup in backend-9am.
close_reason: Implementation complete and validated; external product/variant setup is tracked separately in backend-9am.

title: Keep tunnel is_current accurate for live sessions
description: A duplicate CLI registration for a subdomain that is already connected rewrote the tunnel record and cleared is_current, so the dashboard showed an online tunnel as Offline. Registration now rejects a subdomain that has a live yamux session before touching the record, and only the owning connection clears is_current on disconnect. WebSocket upgrade traffic is also counted toward tunnel usage.
close_reason: Fixed in app/internal/service/tcp.go: live-session check before record writes, ownership-guarded is_current clearing, and upgrade traffic accounting. Verified with go build, go vet, go test and a temporary end-to-end WebSocket upgrade probe.

title: Add aggregate dashboard usage history
description: Persist privacy-safe time-bucketed request and byte counters per tunnel, expose authenticated hour/day/week history through Handler -> Service -> Repository, and power a multi-series usage chart on the consolidated dashboard without storing raw request payloads.
design: Persist fixed UTC 5-minute per-tunnel counters. Repository owns aggregate and bucket writes plus owner-scoped range reads. Service aggregates hour/day/week into 5-minute/hour/day points. Authenticated GET /api/v1/dashboard/usage returns all owned tunnel series; frontend renders it in Dashboard with no separate Usage view.
acceptance_criteria: No raw request content is persisted; usage buckets are user-isolated; /api/v1/dashboard/usage supports hour/day/week; removed dashboard views fall back safely; overview chart handles empty data, range switching, theme colors, and hover details; backend and landing quality gates pass.
notes: Implemented 5-minute privacy-safe buckets, immutable tunnel-ID attribution, owner-isolated history, monotonic lifetime activity, authenticated hour/day/week API, consolidated top-10 chart, safe hash fallback, and compact dashboard layout. Validation: migration smoke test, go test/build, landing lint/tsc/build.
close_reason: Implemented and validated the aggregate dashboard usage feature and restored the pinned Next.js ESLint flat-config quality gate.

title: Build developer tunnel dashboard
description: Replace the minimal post-login screen with a responsive GoPort control plane and add real tunnel status, metadata, stop, and delete support.
close_reason: Implemented responsive dashboard, real tunnel metadata/status/actions, API wiring, and verified production builds.

title: Add hosted dashboard services
description: Add request-event transport and replay, custom-domain DNS verification, subscription billing, invoices, and self-service profile/account APIs behind the dashboard states.

title: Restore landing ESLint quality gate
description: Add and configure the ESLint dependency used by the existing pnpm lint script so dashboard and landing lint checks can run in CI.
close_reason: Implemented and validated the aggregate dashboard usage feature and restored the pinned Next.js ESLint flat-config quality gate.
